title: AdaptArena: Evaluating Test-Time Personalization of Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex web navigation tasks, yet they remain brittle in real-world settings where user intentions are underspecified and preferences are heterogeneous. In practice, users rarely provide explicit profiles, requiring agents to infer latent preferences from implicit signals. Despite its importance for deployment, this problem setting is largely underexplored in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce AdaptArena, a benchmark for evaluating test-time personalization of web agents via implicit preference inference. AdaptArena consists of 480 tasks, featuring both single-preference and double-preference scenarios. Each evaluation task must be solved by retrieving and leveraging the most relevant historical user trajectory that implicitly encodes the target preference. translated_title: AdaptArena：评估网络智能体的测试时个性化能力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂的网页导航任务上已展现出强大的性能，但在用户意图不明确且偏好各异的现实场景中，它们仍然十分脆弱。在实际应用中，用户很少提供明确的用户画像，这要求智能体能够从隐式信号中推断潜在偏好。尽管这一问题对实际部署至关重要，但在现有基准测试中却鲜有研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AdaptArena，一个通过隐式偏好推断来评估网络智能体测试时个性化能力的基准。AdaptArena包含480个任务，涵盖单偏好和双偏好两种场景。每个评估任务都需要通过检索并利用最相关的、隐式编码了目标偏好的历史用户轨迹来解决。此外，我们提出了AdaptiveAgent，一个基于检索的框架，用于标准化的评估。
tldr: 提出AdaptArena基准，通过480个涵盖单偏好和双偏好的任务，评估网络智能体从隐式用户轨迹中推断偏好并实现测试时个性化的能力，并配套提出基于检索的AdaptiveAgent框架。
en_tdlr: AdaptArena is a benchmark of 480 tasks (single- and double-preference scenarios) for evaluating web agents' test-time personalization via implicit preference inference, accompanied by AdaptiveAgent, a retrieval-based framework for standardized evaluation.
